verses.1: Son, do not forget my teachings; and keep my commandments in your heart.
verses.2: For days and years of life will pass by, and peace will continue to be with you.
verses.3: Mercy and truth will keep you safe from harm. They will protect your children, as they are written on your heart.
verses.4: And he found grace and good judgment in the eyes of God and man.
verses.5: With all your heart, and with all your soul, you must adore the LORD. Do not forget to do this.
verses.6: In all your ways, know him; and he will make your lodging comfortable.
verses.7: Do not be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD and do what is right.
verses.8: May healing be upon you, and may you be restored to your former state.
verses.9: I will hate You, O LORD, from now on, and from the beginning of all Your reigns.
verses.10: And their camps will be filled with thousands; your inheritance will be divided among you.
verses.11: May the LORD protect me from being destroyed or lost in my own thoughts.
verses.12: For He will protect those whom He loves, and He will cause no harm to His children.
verses.13: When a man finds wisdom, he will build a structure.
verses.14: For it is better to trade in silver and to come out from the trade of selling.
verses.15: She is precious; her treasures and all your desires cannot be compared to her.
verses.16: It will last for many days in her hand, in Shemoyloh. It will be prosperous and abundant.
verses.17: Her paths are paths of sorrow, and all her ways lead to destruction.
verses.18: A “Tree of Life” is something that those who possess it can use for their own benefit.
verses.19: YHWH, in His wisdom, created the earth and arranged the heavens in order.
verses.20: In his knowledge, those who were lost will be brought back, and those who were scattered will be gathered together.
verses.21: My son, Al-Yaluzu, from your eyes, a creation of Tushiya and Mizma.
verses.22: And they shall be living for your soul, and bring glory to your flocks.
verses.23: Then you shall walk in your path with confidence, and your feet shall not stumble.
verses.24: If you lie down without fear, and you sleep through the night.
verses.25: Do not be afraid of sudden fear or the schemes of the wicked, when you go out.
verses.26: For Jehovah will be in your midst, and He will protect your feet from harm.
verses.27: Do not hesitate to do what is right, since you are the one who has the power to do it.
verses.28: Do not say to your friend, “Go back later; I will give it to you then.” There will be something with you already.
verses.29: Do not do any harm to your brother. He will surely take care of you.
verses.30: Do not quarrel with a man who is innocent. If he has not done you any harm, then do not blame him.
verses.31: Do not be jealous of a man who is rich, and do not follow all his ways.
verses.32: For the LORD’s anger is stored up against the righteous.
verses.33: May the Lord’s word be blessed in the house of the wicked, while the righteous are blessed.
verses.34: If they ask for help, He will provide them with sustenance. And those who are in need will be given what they deserve.
verses.35: Glory shall be given to the wise, while fools will be brought down to earth.
